title: Lesson 3: Discovery and Scoping: Listening Before Proposing
description: The craft of discovery: who to talk to, what to watch, which questions surface the real problem, and how to write a problem statement the client agrees with before you propose any solution.

questions.question: Which statement best reflects the lesson’s guidance?
options: It teaches you how to listen, what to listen for, which questions pull the real problem out of the noise, and how to write a problem statement the client agrees with before you propose anything.
Discovery is not a warm-up before the real work.
It is the phase where you earn the right to propose a solution at all, and it is the phase where most engagements quietly fail.
Lesson 2 gave you the lifecycle and told you that discovery is where the whole engagement is won or lost.
